༄༅/ /lho yi rlung gis dus su bskul te gzan sne lhab lhub bskyod pa yi//gangs ri'i khrod kyi grwa rkyang zhig gi ma bcos snying gi gsang ba dang //mi yul rgyal khams nyul ba'i nyams myong 'byung 'gyur re ba'i phugs bsam bcas//ngag rig sgyu rtsal nyams brgya rdzogs pa'i dasdings rta gnyom po'i rgyud du drangs//grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta zhes pa'i snyan deb 'go brjoje du rme zlol bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bod shing bya zla 12tshes 10la bla rung nas/rgyus med yul gru bskor ba'i grwa rkyang gī/slad me da dung ba zab mo'i dbyangs rta 'di//bden med sgyu ma'i sems kyi tshor snang ste//zhen med mi yul 'grim pa'i rkang rjes lags//zhes 'jigs med bshad sgrub kyis phyi lo nyis stong lnga zla 12tshes10la phul pa dge/

༄tsho//lus kyi khrag thig gangs can yul du 'phos//1/dre/ rme mi ༷//rdoms kya 5na lam chas / nar la gtaspya//snyan rtsom chab dkrir smyug rtse'alam/sa'athar//yaṭ+wāṃmes dam pa' lugs bzong 'a na gsal//lnga ga spang thang tha gru yangs pa nasa'//snyon deb cango shes / pho'i gom sgra 'das//bad ṭ+wāṃg gzhananu'adaburnadagungazlo samaṭ+wāṃ//shes ga gdugs dkar bla na mas gyur ga/ces grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta zhes pa'i snyan rtsom la shes tshig gi tso du shrī seng pa thub bstan tshe 'phel gyis bris/gyi 4 nganyang sna sto

sngon 'gro'i gtam/༈ sa 'dzin dkar po'i phreng ba tshar du mngar ba'i chags dbyibs kyi che ba mtho zhing sman rigs skye dngos kyi dpal ma tshang pa med pa chos ldan bod kyi rgyal khams zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan phyogs su g.yo ba'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'dir 'tsho zhing gzhis chags pa'i mkhyen ldan gyi klog pa po rnam pa/ deng 'dir kun gyis rang nyid kyi brjod 'dod kyi skad cha gang dang bsam tshul gang yang gleng chog pa'i spyi mthun gyi gar stegs su gyur pa'i snyan deb zhes pa 'di/gangs ri'i ri grong kun la dar rgya chen po byung 'dug la de yang bzang ngan sna tshogs zhig 'byung gin yod pa klog pa po rnams la gsal la/ de yang yin te snyan ngag spel pa'i gang zag dag la blo mtho dman med pa zhig dgos pa sus kyang sgrig khrims 'jog mi srid la srid kyang de ltar mi 'ong pa kun gyis shes/des na snyan deb dag la yang blo nus kyi khyad par gyis tshig gi sdeb sbyor snyan mi snyan dang don la zab khyad che na yang rang gi brjod 'dod pa'i don dang rang nyid kyi 'das zin pa'i lo zla'i nang byung ba'i bya las dag la rjes dran zhig byas na mi chog pa gang yang med snyam/ yang phyogs gcig nas bshad na dus deb dang snyan 4

deb dag dgon gnas dang slob grwa dag la dus deb dang snyan deb spesnyel ba'i khyab rgya ha cang che zhing de yang dga' 'os pa zhig ste/ bod rang gi yi ge 'di brtsi 'jog dang rang bdag byed kyin yod pa gsal bas dga' 'os la ma 'ongs pa la yang bod rang gi skad rigs dang rig gnas gang gi phyogs nas nyam pa slar gso dang ma nyam gong spel gtong dgos pa nga tsho'i bod mi yongs kyi 'os 'gan yin/snyan deb dang dus deb 'dis ni dgon gnas kyi bshad grwa dag gi grwa ba dang slob grwa'i slob ma gzhan snyan ngag la dung zhen che ba dag la 'gran bsdur gyi stegs bu zhig kyang bskrun yod la des ni slob ma dag gi slob sbyong la'ang brtson pa byed pa'i bskul cag kyang theb yod par bsam/ de yin na snyan rtsom la dga' ba dag gis snyan ngag gi phyogs la 'bad pa byed cing brtsi mthong byed la srol 'di ma nyam par gong 'phel dang dar rgyas su gyur na yang bod rang gi skad yig gi phyogs nas zhabs 'degs byas yod par snyam/ de'i phyir 'dir yang snyom las pa ming la re skong mkhas grub du 'bod pa bdag gis nye ba'i lo shas ring la snyan ngag gi phyogs la sbyang khul tsam byas pa'i rkyen las deb 'di par du bskrun pa rang nyid kyis rang nyid la rgyugs gzhi bkod pa dang 'dra na yang chung dus myos 5

rang nyid kyis 'bri khul byas pa'i tshig bcad du byas pa 'ga' dang da ltar snyan rtsom zhig gi gzugs ras btod pa rnams phyogs gcig du sdom nas rjes dran gyi tshul dang / rang nyid kyi brjod 'dod pa'i skad cha dag dog snang dang ngo tsha'i bag yod ring du dor nas deb chung 'dir phabs pa yin/ spyir nga rang nyid ni skye sa'i skye khongs dman pa dang rgyu 'byor ba thob shes rgya ci yang med pa'i grwa rkyang zhig yin zhing de bas rang snang gang shar bden bden chog chog gis 'ur rgyag pa'i nus pa dang spobs pa ye nas med/ de yin na yang nga rang yang chung dus nas snyan ngag la dga' ba dang nga'i snying gi grogs pos mthun rkyen dang bskul ba la brten nas ngo tsha med par mkhyen spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi spyan gzugs su 'phul na glen pa'i gar 'cham zhig byas pa la nges par 'gyur ba'i dgongs 'gal med par zhu zhu/ /dpal shrī seng lnga rig nang bstan slob gling nas re skong ba mkhas grub du 'bod pas 2005lo'i zla 11tshes 20la/ /6

dkar chagadad gsol sbrang ma ra'i gshog sgra/ (/)skyabs mgon chen po yid bzhin nor bu mchog rjes su dran pa rtags brgyad gsal pa'irol mo (3)rjes dran dad gsum g.yos pa'i rlabs ris/ (6)bla ma rin po che pad+ma bskal bzang mchog la bstod pa mi to ba'i glu dbyangs// (10)'phrin yig mched grogs dgyes pa'i me tog/ (13)'phrin yig grogs 'dzum bsu ba'i dgod sgra/ (15)sme ngag mchi ma'i rlabs ris/ (18)dbyangs can ma/ (20)mi tshe'i rin thang / (21)glo bur gyi mgyogs bris/ (23)mkhan nyid la bstod pa rkang drug gi bsam pa/ (25)bla ma dam pa'i yon tan gyi zur tsam brjod pa spang rgyan me tog/ (27)bla ma dran pa'i rgyang 'bod sprang po'i sdug glu/ (29)'dod chags rmyon pa'i mdza' gzhas/ (31)tshangs sras dgyes pa'i mchod pa/ (33)1

sems 'gyi/ (34)sbrang ma'i gshog rlabs/ (35)nga'i phu bo rgyang la bzhud dus/ (36)khu lor spreng ba'i gtam/ (37)khyod dran pa'i mtshan mo/ (39)gsang tshig/ (42)bye'u chung co ka/ (44)kha ba 'bab dus/ (46)bdag sgra gsal ba'i co ka/ (48)rdzogs tshigs gsal ba'i nyin tho/ (50)'brel sgras spud pa'i bden don/ (51)phugs bsam/ (53)khu sim sim gyi nyin tho/ (55)dgongs dag zhu/ (58)khyod la ci byung song / (60)mtshan mo zhig gi smag rim khrod nas/ (62)gangs ri'i pho nya/ (64)2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༈ dad gsol sbra ma ra'i gshog sgra//nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus spangs shing 'jam pa'i mtshan ma gsal ba yi//rdul bral zla shel 'od zer stong 'bar lha lam mthong na rgyu ba 'di//ston ka'i dus kyi chu mthong khrod na gzi 'od gsal ba'i ri bong 'dzin//shin tu rgyas pa'i lang tsho'i dpal la gcig tu snyems pa'i dge mtshan mtho//ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rtogs pa ma bcos lhun grub dpal mnga' ba'i /phyogs dang mtha' med bya byed med pa kun la gsal ba'i ngo mtshar 'di//sprin dang khug sna sgrib pa bral ba lha yi rdzing bu chen po la//ches cher rgol ba bkra shis legs tshogs srid pa gsum gyi khyon las 'gong //rkang gnyis mchog gyur 'gro ba'i mgon gyis khyod nyid gsal stong chen por lta//bdag nyid kyis ni bcu drug gzhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i lha la bsam//gsal stong mnyam nyid spros pa bral ba gnas lugs don gyi lha chen po//bcu drug gzhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas pa nyi tshe ba yi snang tshul yin//rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa gcig bsdus dpa' bo khyod kyi thugs rje yi//rta bdun bdag po stong gi gzi 'od gcig du 'khyil ba'i mtshan kha 'dis//1

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/na sasum skye bo'i blo yi rmongs mun skad cig 'joms pa'i mthu mnga' phyir//rgyu skar lam na 'od zer spro ba'i rta ljang can de gang gis yin//mthong ba tsam gyis rmongs pa sel ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i mtshan dpe yi//'char ka'i mtshams sprin 'od ris 'khyug pa ma mjal skyo gdung char rgyun spel//ka dag chos kyi gnas lugs gzhi nas lha khyod zhal ris mi 'dzum par//ma zad bdag rgyud nyon mongs chen pos yongs su sgrub pa de yis kyang //ma rig smag rim stug po'i khrod nas ngu ngag mtsho mo bsribs pa las//dad gsol mdangs ldan pad+ma dkar po thags su rgyas pa'i phreng ba 'di//sor bcu'i snyim pa snying gar btags shing gus pa'i gar gyis mngon mchod na//thuṭa rje chu 'dzin dkriṭa pa'i dkyil nas sbrang char bsil ma'i dngos grub phobs//pho+obs shog snying rje'i char ldan klong nas gsungs dbyangs sgra brgya dgod bzhin ro/ga/phyar shog bdag blo'i rmongs pa bsgral phyir shes rab ri mtshon 'phyar nas shog/'dzum shog li khri'i 'od zhags brnon po ngag rigs gzhi la 'dzum bzhin shog/byon shog mkhyenapa'idabangaphyugachenapoṭ+wāṃdagagispyibor myur bar byon//

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅// skyabs mgon chen po yid bzhin nor bu mchog rjes su dran pa rtags brgyad gsal ba'i rol mo//rdul bral stong dbyings mtshan dpe'i mja' ris snying rje'i mthu las rab bzhad pa//gru 'dzin bdag po gdul bya'i mkha' la gang 'tshams sprul ba'i zlos gar rdul//phyogs kyi bu mo'i mdza' bor 'tham pa mos pa'i bdud rtsi'i zeg zer gang //kha 'bab chu bzhi'i mthu dpong bskyed pa sprul ba sku yi tshogs la 'dud//kha ba'i rdul brtsegs pad dkar lto bar gdul byar ting 'dzin zab mo'i 'od//ring nas 'phros shing rngams nag las nyon sgrin pa'i gzhi las sdug bsngal char//zlog med gtses pa'i las can bsrung la yid bzhin gdugs dkar nam mkha'i nor//ba gam chags pa'i ngo mtshar 'od 'dzum bstan 'gro'i don chen rgyalda mtshan mtho//sngur smrig ka ma la yi mdzes sdug dri bral zhabs sen mu tugaphreng //khams gsum drang bsrung bye ba'i gtsug tu gnyen pa'i snyim pa rab tu mang //3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/sku yi mtshan dpe brjod pa'i grags dkar skyes pa lnga ba'i snyan 'gyur dbyangs//gang gi sgra 'dzin bu mo'i skom du btung na bdud rtsi'i dpal yang nongs//gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug bcu'i cha rdzogs mdangs gsal 'khyug ldan gser gyi nya //lus can khams kyi mtsho la brtsen pas rnyog bral dwangs gsal rlabs ris ltem//thuṭa gsang chos mdzod 'dod 'byung bum bzang sa gzhi chen po'i rdul gyi grangs//sems can blo la gang mos gang 'tsham sbyin la ngad dang zad pa med//gang khyod mdzad bzang mthon 'thing yangs pa byis blos dpag par sbobs ma yin//'on kyang blo chung khab mig tsam gyis dbang byed mdzad pa btso ma'i thig/lhag bsam dad pa'i bur gyi ri mos snyim pa'i mdza' mor nyer 'khyil na//dge leṭa bsod nams zla zer dwangs ma sun dhi'i dpal la legs phyin shog/srid zhi'i yang dben chos nyid rang bzhin bzhin dgyes chu shel dbang po'i cha//ma lus rdzogs pa'i 'dzum gser gshis ka ka dag klong la mi spro bar//bska 8rmi ba rdu9ri phran 'khrigs pa'i dbyings las las can skyongs bar rjes brtse'i 4

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/ngang cizhabs pad 'dab stong phyogs su rgyas shing shing drung zin pa'i bskal ba skrun//ke la sha yi sbubs su nub pa'i gang gā'i phye ma'i rdul snyed kyi//grangs la 'gran pa'i rkang gnyis mig mchi'i rlabs phreng rab tu g.yos pa'i rtser//thams cad mkhyen pa'i snang byed zer brgya gzhan du phyogs pa'i dog pa brtsen//zhabs ris 'dab ldan 'od mdangs gsal ba kha ba'i me tog khri la byon//shing bya lo'i hor zla bcu gcig dkar phyogs skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gnang skabs sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/dze7 kā r+sha5dzālngek+ṣengarī༄༄ri/srurnyiriri/(/(/rmā/phro dorici〉〉gci— chini//sdi riri ) phomu / ri༄61)/ rjo 7/7 /risdosrolnge ri phro byon/ tshopatsho(tshordotshorishrīne+ed+ngha rme—1(tsho5

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /rjes dran dad gsum g.yos pa'i rlabs ris/rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi mdza' mo 'jo sgeg stong ldan shes rab lha mo dbyangs can mas//'gro la rjes chags 'od dkar dpal 'dzoms mig 'bras gsal ba nyam thag 'gro la mi zha na//rmongs pa'i mtsho las rab tu ldang ba'i dad gsol chu khur shin tu ngus pa'i char gyi thug/ du+os kun gtor ba'i shes pa'i dben pa sprang po'i bu la tam bu ra yi dpal zhig 455//dhī yig mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan 'bar ba 'char ka'i mdangs 'dzin ye shes me long brtse 'dzum gyis//rlung gi rgyal mtshan gar du brtsen pa'i sgyu ma'i sprul ba mdo khams dpal la blaskugs shākyab pa//'jigs med rta bdun bdag pos don gnyis phun tshogs 'od snang 'gro la khyab pa 'byung ba'i gnas//tsan+da dha ma ṇi mtshan gyi grags dkar phyogs kyi bu mo'i lan bu las 'gongs khyod 6

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/kyis dgongs//sngon tshe khyod kyis mdo khams sa 'dzin rtse lnga la lung dben gnas chos kyi dga' tshal du//dge ba'i chos char me tog bsung ldan dge mtshan dpal reg yangs bar sbyin pa'i dus kyi tshe//'khor lnga'i chu gter char ka'i mdangs rdzogs rkang drug tshogs rnams zur zur glu dbyangs ci yang len//spangs rtogs ro+ol mos phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba shin tu myos pa'i zhal 'dzum zer brgya yang yang spra//nyon mongs bdud mo nag po'i sgrib rnams legs pa'i tshul lam dge ba'i khrims kyis 'degs 'jogs bsgyur//gang yong bzod pa'i ting 'dzin me tog dza ha'i bu mo mtshar sdug lang tsho phyogs su 'phya//shes bya'i gangs ri stan tu byas pa'i mkhas pa gangs seng g.yu ral dkrug pa bgrang yas pa//lha yi rdzung bu ring mo'i khrod na 'od ris 'byug pa rgyu skar tshogs la ci 'dra byed//7

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/moda' lnga can gyis sprul ba'i bdud dpong gnam sa g.yo ba'i me char 'bar ba spras pas kyang //snyingo rje'i sgro ldan byang sems gzi ldan she waṃ zung 'jug 'od phung gzhi las ma g.yas par//rang sar zhu ba'i rdzu 'phrul gsar ba'i chu shel dbang po srid gsum rtse na 'od zer spro//e ma sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras yid bzhin nor bu khyod kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung // de ltar snyan pa'i grags dkar bu mo gar stabs ldem pa'i dus skabs la//rkang gnyis mchog gyur rgyal sras chen pas 'gro don snang ba'i mtha' bsdus te//'khor slob mtsho kha'i ngang ba'i sde la zhal 'cham rlabs phrang rab spel ba//rango tshigs ma shor gzhan sems ma dkrugs zhes pa'i gser gyi thig rgyun bkad//'og min bde ldan 'od lnga'i zhing la gser zhal 'dzum par spro ba yis//lha mo 'bum gyis bsu ma'i mchod pa man dwa ra yi me tog gtor//rnga dang rol mo'i mchod sprin klong nas dgyes zhal ri bong 'dzin pa'i grogs//8

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/—'dzum bzhin 'dzum bzhin bde ldan zhing la zhabs sems gsal ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs//kye ma kyi khul 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon bu nga gsas pa'i bla ba lags//nged cag dwa phrug mang srang tshogs kyis ma 'ongs lo zla ring mo'i nang //sems kyi gtad so gang la byed dam rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon//gziṭa sam mchi ma mtsho ru 'khrul ba gzigs sam gzigs sam bla ma lags//kye ma lha khyod thugs rjes ldan na bla rung chos kyi mtsho ma'i dbus//zhabs sen 'dab stong ri mo bkod la nyi zla'i phreng las mi 'gyang bar//bkro shis mtshan ltas 'bum gyis btaṭa nas myur ba myur bar byin chen 'phabs /bkra shis rjes su dran pa'i sprin dkar gyi 'dab ma//dad pa'i gri gzhon bu mos mkha' dbyings su gtor bas//bsod nams sprin gyi me tog thar thor gyi do shel//mgon khyod zhal 'dzum gsar ba'i mthun rkyen du bsngo'o//shing lo'i zla bdun pa'i dkar phyogs la mtsho sngon khri shor rgyal mo'i nye 'gram nas snyom las pa reb skong mkhas grub du 'bod pas//9

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /bla ma rin po che pad+ma skal bzang mchog la bstod pa mi to ba'i glu dbyangs//bskal mang rdul phran dkrigs pa'i gdeng ka na/ /ngo mtshar rnam mthar rta bdun 'bar ba'i gzi/ /deng yang gsal ba mi nub dha dza ka/ /pad ma rgyal po'i mdzad rjes e ma ho/ /de yi zlas gar snang byed 'dzum pa'i zer/ /blo dman mes long yid kyi grogs su ci/ /'on kyang las smon spang ljongs sngon mo'i gzhir/ /lha yi bu chung zhig gi dgyes zhal mthong / /mchog gyur 'dzam bu khri shing mdzes pa ldan/ /nyorno mongs dug mtsho brdol ba deng gi dus/ /sprul ba pad+ma 'dzum pa'i rdzogs ldan pa/ /bskal bzang slob 'bang bung ba'i dpyid du shar/ /1 0

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/mgon po khyod kyi mdzad pa'i ka bur zeg /sa gsum skye bo'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i khyon/ /gang mthun bsnod du 'beb pa'i bro gar gyis/ /lha dbang rgya zhin blo yang me+ongs bar byed/ /gdod ma'i rgyal sa'i lhun grub gser gyi khrir/ /mgon khyod zhabs kyi chu skyes snga nas bkod/ /slar yang snying rje'i thur mas yongs bskul nas/ /gnas 'dir zlas pa e ma thugs rje che/ /gzugs sku'i rta bdun shin tu rgyas pa yis /mda' lnga can gyi blo yi mun pa gsal/ /ngur smig gos kyi lu khri'i gzi dpal la/ /bdud pho lha'i phyin sred pa'i rgya la lhung / /1 1

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/gsungs dbyangs dri bral shel kyi tam bu ra/ /lan gcig dkrol bas srid pa gsum gyi 'gro'i/ /rna yi dbang po'i bcu drug lang tsho can/ /rang dbang bral ba'i mtsho la ngang gis zhugs/ /khyod thugs rdul bral stong ba gnam mkha' che/ /bde gshegs bye ba'i dgongs par dbye ba gang / /mi phyed dad pa'i mtsho las zhabrungs ba'i snying / /skyes mchog khyod la mi gtod gang su la/ /mgon po gang la bstod pa'i 'o ma'i thig /lhag sems bsil rlung g.yos pa'i sems pa yin/ /cung zad bsngags pa'i skra rtse'i chu thig la / /brten 'byung dge ba ci mchis kun la bsngo/ /1 2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /'phrin yig mched grogs dgyes pa'i me tog/lnga rig 'dab ldan dri bsung ldang ba yongs 'dus dga' tshal chen po na//sbrang rtsi'i bcud la legs par spyod la dga' ba 'phyo ba'i sbra ma ra//deng gi dus na gzhan rkyen med par mtha' dag nya rgyas zla ba'i dper//shin tu 'os par dge legs yi ges snyan pa'i 'bod pa lan gcig bsgrog/rgyal ba dam pa'i gsung gi snying po gcig tu 'khyil ba'i mtsho mo las//mchog tu 'khrungs pa don gnyis me tog pad+ma dkar po gcig pu ste//de la 'bad par phyi nang bdud phos mngar sgra rgod pa ches che nas//gang nyid sku gsung thugs kyi dge mtshan chags 'jug med pa'i khams 'dri zhu//blo gang gang la zhen log med pa gti mug lci ba'i gyi na ba//nga dang nga yi chags pa'i srad bu thar med nyer rgyur bskrun byas nas//skabs dang skabs min dus gsum kun tu le lo'i grogs la bsten pa'i ngang //ya chen dpar ri gnyis pa zhes grags sa yi cha na skyid cing bde//lhag bsam 'o ma'i mdangs las 'phos pa'i gzhan phan phyag zung rkyong ba yis//phyogs gang kun la dge mtshan gsal zhing dga' ba'i snang ba rab tu bskrun//1 3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7// 'phrin yig grogs 'dzum bsu ba'i dgod sgra//mtsho sngon nor bu'i me tog mchog ste sa thob chos kyi dga' tshal du//ngur smig ga shel g.yo ba'i snying por brtse sems lang tsho kun rdzogasapa//kun phan snang ba phyogs kyi bu mo'i lan bu las ni ring song ba//de yi zhabs sen zla ba'i ri mo 'jig rten skyes bus mchod pa'i drung //ring nas 'dris pa'i brtse ba'i 'o mtsho lan gcig g.yos pa'i rlabs phreng las//legs par zhabrungs pa'i brjod don glu dbyangs tam bu ru yi rgyud sbyar nas//zol sbyor ngan pa'i rang gshis slad med btso ma'i mdangs kyis gusa'abul na//dgyes bzhad 'od snang mkha' las dgongs ba'i smon pa'i sbrangs char ci yang 'beb//ke la sha yi mu 'khyul grub pa'i kha ba'i skyes tshal nyams dga' bar//ston pa gang gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i li khru'i rgya mtsho ltem pa'i klong / /gcig tu bstan la brtse ba dam pa nyi mo'i skar ma'i rnam thar la /bsngags par 'os so khyod kyang de yi rnam thar skyongs la grogs rdo rje/ /legs pa'i 'od zer sa gsum khyab par bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs pa la/ /1 5

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang bstun sna tshogs rol bas dam pa'i chos/ /char du 'beb pa dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin la mchog tu bsngags/ /de yi gling la khyod las gzhan pa deng gi dus su bslebs pa bskal/ /don bzang spos dkar dri bsung zhum po gri bzhon bu mo'i mdza' bor sdeb/ /phyogs dang phyoṭa la bar bsang med par dge mtshan gsar ba'i thul ba na/ /bdag kyang de yi bsung gis myos nas sor mo bcu bo'i 'du byed kyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i rdzas la pad+ma'i snyim pa ngang gis bkod/ /de ltar gzhan phan lhag bsam mnga' ba grogs kyi dwangs ma gang khyod la/ /sku la bdud kyis 'tshe ba bral zhing mdzad pa dge las ma g.yos par/ /bkra shis khri la sen ris 'khod la dge slob zung gis gus pa'i ngang / /'tsham zhu dang ni smon pa gsol ba'i me tog phreng ba skyes su 'bul/ /nged gnyis sa mtha'isbrang bo'i lus la na ba'i ba mos ma reg par/ /nges pa don gyi zab gsang chos de nyan pa'i bgo bskal byung gyur kyang / /sems dpa' bye ba'i lam gyi dpal la bzang po'i spyod pas ma bsleb nas/ /le lo'i bu la grogs su byas nas deng gi dus na bde bar mchis/ /1 6

hūṃsiwa ༵stseXwasgyibye~Xwarawariwa༄༄ — ༄jismrodze+ewaXwatshuhūṃhūṃrnyisnyoriwarariri bye ri wa༄༄ ༄ri zhe ༄ riri trīsiruri༄༄ ༄༄ririshisnyobyene+ewahūṃwasnyeram̐Xñtsāsahūṃdz+rasi ༄snga༄risnyosnyo༄si ritwebyeXririri〉)—di3noglodzāspreXri ༄sdoslornyu༄ri ༄risngetswawarilir ra ༄ ༄t+t+waṃsigyirdzesari)dro༄snga risnye5 spreskred+kuchi༄ribyezhu trīXr+yā ri༄ririrnyosteri risi༄sdor riri༄byesdawa4ne+ejuriri ribyesbyornihūṃbyestiḍi༄smo 'a ri si ri stsetrīXbye/༷ riri ༄ ༷nariXwa~X༄༄༷hūṃbyesnosnyeskreltowasmoṭ+wāṃ si stseji 'iri risto༄thatsā riririri skuca༄ ri si༄stuwar+sā durirno/༄ sidro ༄siXrnyo ༄ririsdewariwasiXne+eristsehūṃsnyo༄rā3zu/ d+me ra 4k+ṣe— snga༄dro༄

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7//sme ngag mchi ma'i rlabs ris//rab dkar gzi mdangs 'bar ba snying rje yi bdag nyid//sa gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig spyan ras gzigs mkhyen no//dug lnga rgyud la 'byams pa'i tha shul kyi bu la//dgongs su gsol lo 'jig rten dri mdzin gyi dbang phyug/snga nas bag la zha ba'i bdag 'dzin gyi skyur rtsis//yang dang yang du skye rgu'i sdug bsngal la spyad cing //blangs dor 'byed pa'i blo gros mun klong la lhung nas//'jig rten srid pa'i rgan mor bden 'dzin de cher byas//deng dus legs lam dam pa'i lam mchog zhig rnyed kyang //las nyon thor rlung rgod po phyogs med du lding ba'i//rdul bral 'od gsal chen po nag nog gis bsgrib cing //dam pa'i lam mchog 'di yang rdzob nyen la ltas 'dug/gdod ma'i sa la nyer kho'i byang chub gyi sems pa//nyon mongs dug mtsho 'bar ba'i gting mtha' la skrad do//1 8

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/snying rje bcos ma'i rang tshigs zhe sding gi dkrigs te//rang nyid bde bar chagasapa'i rgya mtsho de 'phyur nas//na gzhon mdzes ma'i lus la khrag 'thung gi srin po//shin tu rngams pa'i las la nyin mtshan kun g.yo zhing //'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po stong dbyings su 'khyams song //mi chos brdzun gyi 'khor lo phyogs med du bskor zhing //rtsa ba'i dam tshigs bu mo snang med du bskyur song //kye ma spyan ras gzigs dbang las nyon gyi rngon pa//dam mnyam bu nga'i nyon mongs gshed po la byon shogs//mgon khyod zhabs sen 'od risaspyi bo la rag par//skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs lu gu yi rgyud du//mi phyed dad pa'i me tog snying dbus nas bkod na//smon pa'i 'bras bu ji bzhin 'grub pa la ma g.yo//1 9

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma//bcu drug lang tsho'i zla gzhon tshangs sras ma'i/ /'jo sgeg 'od zer srid pa gsum las 'gong / /snyan 'gyur bye ba'i cha rdzogs rol mo 'bum/ /cig char dkrol ba'i rol gar ngo mtshar mtho/ /sa gsum skye bo nyon mongs stug po'i yid/ /ma khyod chags pa'i mtsho mo mkha' la 'phyo/ /gsol tshigs me tog dkar po'i phreng ba yang / /yang dag 'grub pa'i phyogs su yang yang gtor/ /khyod thugs stong dbyings chu 'dzin ldem pa las/ /yang dag mthong ba'i rigs pa'i rtsal zhig stsol/ /gnas lugs dam pa gang 'dod smra ba yi/ /dus gsum 'gag pa med pa'i ngag zhig stsol/ /2 0

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /mi tshe'i rin thang //'jig rten tho yor mi lus blangs ba la/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal me ri'i dpong kha mtho/ /rga ba'i sdug bsngal nyin mtshan bar med 'bab/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal skad cig ngang gis slebs/ /mdzes ma'i lus la mig 'bras 'khor ba ngas/ /pha mas gso skyongs rin chen nor bu de/ /snang med gad snyigs khrod du brtse med dor/ /yul gzhan sdom bu zhig la smon pa btang / /sa mtha'i grong sgo myul ba'i 'khyam pol/ /mi kha'i lhag rlung nyin mtshan b.ramed lding / /skyo gdong semasakyi gzhisakar drod khol mnyam/ /sdug bsngal dar la 'byar ba yun tsam min/ /shāṇ+ḍi 1 —

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/bco brgyad lang tsho ngur smig gos kyis g.yog /bu mo zhig la sems kyi me kha bzos/ /na mnyam me tog tshom las rgyang la gyed/ /yod tshad yal bor ba rmongs pa nga / /na chung mdzes ma'i me tog rjes la rgyugs/ /dam tshig lcags sgrog rigs nas phyir la gyed/ /sdom pa yod med the tshom dgos pa ngas/ /mi tshe'i rin thang don med las kyis zad/ /2 2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /glo bur gyi mgyog bris//re skong rigs 'byunga.u tam wa ra'i tshal /rnam shes 'khyam po'i sbrang ma'i las 'bras smin/ /thog ma'i ngu skad gshogs zung g.yos pa'i sgra/ /byams ldan me tog zhig gi phang nas 'then/ /dga' skyo'i drod 'khyag 'dras pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod/ /lo gcig lo gnyis kha char rim gyis lud/ /bco lngalilang tsho'i gangs ri thol gyis bud/ /'jig rten snang ba'i gangs chu 'beb 'go tshigs/ /bcu drug na chung ma yi me tog la/ / brtse dung sbrang char bsil ma'i char thigs chags/ /phan tshun sems la bzhags pa'i ze'u 'bru la/ /mi kha'i sad ser 'phog pa lan gcig min/ /bco brgyad na tshod lo 'go'i ljangs smyug dus/ /blo kha chos la phyogs pa'i bsil rlung ldang / /2 3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/grwa rkyang 'tsho ba'i gru khar 'grul bzhud byas/ /na mnyam pho mos co 'dra'i me phung 'bar/ /kher rkyang khang mug zla gam gsar ba'i nang / /dang po skyid snang sprin dkar lang long dkrigs/ /bar du skyid sdug mtshe'u bar med skyoms/ /'tha' mar sdug snang mun pa kun tu 'thub/ /rang sems nang du bkug pa'i gzhi mo la/ /'gyod pa'i smig sprin la khar yang yang g.yo/ /'dod chags rgya stag bud med lus la rngam /nyon mongs rlung 'tshub sngar las chas cher ldang / /blo phugs thung ba'i col chung sprel 'u yi/ /bya las ba mo na bun 'khrigs pa mgyogs/ /don ldan snyim pa nor bu tha snyad tsam/ /kun gyis dmod pa'i las zhig rang gis byas/ /2 4

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /mkhan nyid la bstod pa rkang drug gi bsam pa//sngon tshe shrī seng chos kyi chu gter klong //mi pham rgyal mchog snang byed ma ṇi ka//mdzes par 'khrungs zhing 'phrin las 'od phung 'bar /lus can bye ba gtan bde'i sa la bkod/ /deng dus snyigs ma'i nyon mongs ro myag gzhir/ /gang khyed u tam wa ra bsil zer can/ /ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i rgyal mtshan gdugs dkar sgreng / /blo dman bdag 'dra'i skye bor legs lam bstan/ /gang khyed 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i legs bshad de/ /rkang gnyis byis blo'i dpal la rab spel tshe/ /mi shes mun pas rgol ba'i dogs bral zhing / /shes rab sgron me gsal ba'i rgyal rnga brdung / /2 5

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/khyed sku ri rgyal rta bdun bdag po'i dpal/ /g.yo med bskal ba'i dza k+ka rgyan gyur na/ / mi dge 'grin bcu'i 'tshe ba ye bral nas/ /'khor slob dga' ba'i dga' ston kun tu gsal/ /mchog gsum bslu med yongs 'dus chen po la/ /dad gsol snyim pa 'dab ldan mu tig phreng / /yang yang gtad pa'i bden stobs tshe yi lhas/ /mgon khyod srid mtha'i bar du 'tsho gzhis gsol/ /rmo tsho rmo tshisdormormedze tsho ṭ+wā+oṃ—— gu'i perdacwasiri(k+ṣ-i//tsho— rī (tshoske hwa37) ri)) ci/ // zu ///ji / di/ri rdzo0lanyu cici4ghu ༄ shātsho 7/ / risdo)shrī༄hūm̐lhirdordo / rmer+sha1tshotshormāphro 2 6

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i yon tan gyi zur tsam brjod pa spang rgyan me tog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs sras/ /slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ /mi yi gar du byon pa/ /'jam dbyangs lung rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i gsungs bcud/ /klong chen snying gi thig le/ /tshe gcig grol ba'i chos mchog /rdzogs chen a ti yo ga /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du/ /dgung gi nyi bzhin bzhugs pa/ /snying rje'i spyan ras gziṭa dbang / /'jam dbyangs lungs rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /dmar ser li khri'i mdangs ldan/ /gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug /ral gri mkha' la 'phyar ba/ /'jam dbyangs lungs rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /gsang sngags bka' yi bdag po/ /mthu dang stobs kyi mnga' bdag /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ /'jam dbyangs lung rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /2 7

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/thegs pa rim dgu'i gtsug rgyan/ /rdzogs chen snying gi thig le/ /snod ldan bu la spyin pa/ /'jam dbyangs lungs rtogs rgyal mtshan/ / rigs kun 'dus pa'i khyab bdag /'jam dbyangs lungs rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /dad pa'i gsol ba btabs na/ /slu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas/ /gsang bsngags chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ /nyi zla'i grogs bzhin bsgreng ba/ /kun bzang chos kyi rgyal po/ /nga yi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /mdo bsngags chos kyi bang mdzod/ /bdud bya'i khams dbang mos pas/ /bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'beb pa/ /nga yi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /nga yi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /'jam dbyangs lungs rtogs rgyal mtshan/ /mi 'jigs khri la bzhugs nas/ /sku tshe nam mkhar mnyam shog /2 8

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /bla ma dran pa'i rgyang 'bod sprang po'i sdug glu/ /ka dag 'gyur ba med pa'i chos sku yi zhing na/ /khyab bdag mgon po kun tu bzang po yi ngo bo/ /chos kyi rje bo 'jam dbyangs bla ma de khyen no/ /nyon mongs grogs la brtse ba'i slob bu la gzigs mdzod/ /nyon mongs dug nag 'bar ba'i rlabs kha na g.yo ba'i/ /bu ngas pha ma dran 'dra'i gdung dbyangs kyis 'bod na/ /snying rje zhags pa dkar pos nyams chung gi bu lo/ /rnam mkhyen dag pa'i zhing la dbugs dbyung re byed mdzod/ /ma rigs gtu mug nag po'i mun dung la lhung tshe/ /pha khyod dwa phrug bu yis ma dran ltar bos na/ /mun sel nyi ma gzhon nu'i gzi dpal de bzhin du/ /nus med bu lo bdag la shes rab zhig stsol zhig /2 9

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/le lo'i grog rong zab mo'i g.yang kha la lhung nas/ /mchi ma'i mtsho mo bskyil te gsol ba rang 'debs na/ /thugs rje'i snang ba dkar po'i phyag zung de brkyang nas/ /le lo'i g.yang las bsgrol ba'i mthu stobs de bskyel shog /grogs ngan 'tshub ma nag pos logs lam la drangs tshe/ /bas pa thang la lhung ba'i ngu skad kyis 'bod na/ /ma ltar brtse ba chen po'i dpung shigs shig bskyel nas/ /dam pa'i legs lam zin pa'i spobs pa zhig stsol mdzod/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i nag po'i sgo la 'grum dus/ /'jigs skrag 'khrul snang zhi ba'i gsol ba zhig 'debs na/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gzugs sku mngon sum du mjal nas/ /gdod ma'i btsan sa zin pa'i dngos grub cig zhu'o/ /3 0

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /'dod chags rmyon pa'i mdza' gzhas//lho phyogs mon gyi yul nas phebs pa de min zhing / /tshang tshing g.yu lo'i tshal gyi 'dab ldan de min pa'i/ /khyod gsung ka la ping ka'i skad snyan de phra mos/ /sprang phrug nga yi sgra 'dzin lha phrug 'di bslus song / /bde ldan chos kyi zhing nas byon pa de min la/ /ba'i mtha' 'grim nas nyon mongs sbyang ba yang min pa'i/ /khyod sems byang chub sems ma'i rang gzhin gyi dpal 'dis/ /'dod ldan bu nga'i dran pa sdug bsngal la sbyar song / /sgo nga'i sbub las gzugs gzhi chags pa de min zhing / /yan lag drug pa'i mtshan gyi 'bod pa yang med pa'i/ /khyod gzugarme rma bya dgyes pa'i mtshar sdug gi lang tshos/ /3 1

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/dben gnas sgom chen pa de grong khyer la bkug byung / /khyod ni bdag sdug sel ba'i chags bral gyi sangs rgyas/ /skyo gdung snang ba gso ba'i khu byug de sngon mo/ /'jig rten bde ba gter ba'i byams sems kyi bdag nyid/ /bdag gis gces su 'os pa'i brang gzhung gi snying chung / /kun la btsal yang thob dka' 'dod 'byung gi nor bu/ /cas kyang kho ba lus kyi zung khrag de dmar po/ /khyod dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal phye mtshan gyi nya mo/ /dngos nas bshad par dka' 'o snying sdug gi mdza' mo/ /3 2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /tshangs sras dgyes pa'i mchod pa//ma khyod sku lus bsil zer dgyes pa'i dpal/ /dge mtshan gsal ba'i ri mo rnam par bkra/ /reg 'jam lang tsho dkar po'i mdzes sdug dag /lus can bye ba'i yid la shin tu mdza'/ /gsungs dbyangs drug 'gyur gzhan gsos dgad pa'i sgra/ /rkang gnyis 'gro ba'i nyan byed dpyid du 'khor/ /yid kyi skyo snang sel ba'i byung ba 'di/ /snyan 'jebs mgrin sgra de yi nus mthu yin/ /khyod thugs chos dbyings spros bral lha lam la/ /blo bur dri mas sgrib gsal ye bre yang / /sna tshogs gzugs kyi bkod pa dpag yas pa/ /ches cher mngon pa e ma blo las 'gong / /3 3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅ sems 'gyi//nga rang gnyid ma khugs pa'i mtshan mo la/ nga'i sems pas 'di ltar gnyer ma'i khengs pa'i rgan po zhig gi bzhin ras la snyan ngag smas/sngon gyi las dbang zhig la/ /gangs ri'i 'dab nas skyes byung / /skyes pa don ldan min pa'i/ /nor nag rmig rjes ltos song / /chung skyes byams pa sgrol mar/ /tshe gcig las bskal bcol yod/ /las kyi 'tshub ma ldang nas/ /brtse dung dbyings su khur song / /sdug bsngal mi la ma bshad/ /dag pa'i lha la zhus yod/ /mig mchi phyi la ma phud/ /sems pa'i btung chu byas yod/ /dad pa lha la bzhags kyang / /rnam shes mi la shor song / /shor ba 'bras med yin kyang / /chu bor yar ldog mi 'dug /dam mnyam lha la ma dgos/ /mi ngan mi la ma dgos/ /mi tshe rlung kha'i bal mo/ /blo rtse gtod sa stong song / /gshin lam ring mo'i khrod nas/ /rnam shes bya spu rlung khyer/ /rang byas sdug bsngal tsha bo/ /myong ba rnam smin yin nam/ /shing bya lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes 14mtshan mor//3 4

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /sbrang ma'i gshog rlabs//khu byug byang la 'phur sang / /g.yu 'brug lha la bzhud sang / /gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir/ /dbyar gyi mdzes sdug stong song / /me tog spang nas skams song / /rdza chu dzo nas skams song / /gangs can ri chu thang gsum/ /dga' spro'i dpal yon bor song /nyi ma nub la nub song / /zla ba tshang nas ma shar/ /mun nag 'jig rten 'di na/ /bod mi'i las dbang sdug pa/ /'brong rgod rdza mgo snyeg song / /'brong ma rdza sked 'grim song / /'obrong phrug las dbang gnyom po/ /rdza 'dab myul dgos byung song / /rgad pa dgung la 'phur sang / /brag dmar stang bar gyur sang / /rtsal med rgod phrug nyams chung / /mi 'dod sdug gis mnar song / /lha la snying rje yod na/ /srongs mar nus mthu yod na/ /mgon med dwa phrug dag la/ /thugs rje phyag zung rkyongs shog /3 5

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /nga'i phu bo rgyang la bzhud dus/ /nga'i phu bo sa mtha' 'grum shul nas/ /sems dmar po zhig la gas chag shor/ /mig chu ma zhig gi chu sbyo/na spel/ /ngag ngu skad zhig gi ri lung bsgul/ /nga'i phu bos gzhan yul bsten shul na/ /sbra nag po'i khyim gzhi'i drod khol nyams/ /sbra nag po'i rlung rta sa la rgud/ /sbra nag po'i skye 'chi gri rtser babs/ /nga'i phu bo rgyang la bzhud shul nas/ /gangs dkar po'i thol la sprin nag 'khrigs/ /gangs dkar po'i mdzes sdug sa la lhung / /gangs dkar po'i sgo zog gzhan dbang gyur/ /3 6

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/khu tshur mngar kha 'dran pa'i gtam rgyud bklaṭa//nyin mtshan phreng ba le lo kho nas bgreng //gzhan gyi 'phya dmod phang la mgo bo sgur//snying gi khrag rtsa 'gad ba'i dug rdzas 'di//rang byas rnam smin lci mo su la gleng //dga' 'dzum 'bum gyisaltams pa'i dus bzang la//re ba'i mig zung cer ba'i pha ma yi /re sgug me tog stong ba'i dbyings su bzhud//spro dga'i rol mo dusamatha'i rlung gis bos//sa mtha'i lhag rlung rtsib mo'i thog bar nas//lang tsho'i rin thang don med char gyis zeg/mdun bskyod goms sgra phye thang skya bor 'grum//gnong 'gyod lci mos rang la mtha' tshig bris//rang tshang gsal ba'i ngag rigs skya po 'di//le los khur ba'i bye 'u'i don gtam yin//lo chung rnam rig 'phar ba'i sbrang ma la//slab bya'i rol dbyangasazhig gi re ba btang //7 7

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/shes bya'i skad ngag 'gran pa'i skyel tshal nas//mtshan rtsal 'bri mo bzho ba'i phyi rol mas//mdzes sdug lhag pas gtses pa'i bu mo 'di//sems pa skyo ba'i gting mthar nya bzhin brtsen//sbra nag bde sdug 'tsho ba'i skye bu 'di//legs nyes gnas lugasabardar la me+ongs luṭa kyis//dad pa'i gnyen gnas chos pa brdzun mas bzung //nad pa'i tshe srog don med phyi mar skyur//la rgya rigs pas rtsod pa'i rgya lam nas//gri yi brno mngar gleng ba'i pho sar 'dis//phye leb me la gceb pa'i skyo gar las//zla khyim brgal ba'i rkang rjes ga la zhog/phyi rol dpyid rlung lding ba'i dus skabs na//bod mi'i las dbang kha ba'i bar na lus//bod mi'i bsgrol stangs g.yang dkar lug khyur 'groṭa//bod mi'i bsal blo gdod ma'i rjes la snyeg/7 9

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /phyir dran la 'bor ba'i mig chu/ /'dang dgong gnyid du yur ba'i zhing khams nas//lus zung ril cing rga ba'i ston rlung gis//dbang med khyer ba'i pha mar zhal mjal byung //dga' spro'i dpyid dpal mchi ma kho nas bsu//dbyar gsum khams sdong rtse yi khams bu 'di//ston gsum lhag rlung rgod po'i gdong la lhung //kha sang lang tshos phyug pa'i pha ma yang /de ring rga ba'i duḥkhar ngang gis 'phyan//dgun mal bu yug 'tshib pa'i 'khor yug na//bde drod lus la ster ba'i drod khol med//skad cig 'gyur ba'i srin mo'i 'jig rten na//lang tsho dar rgyud skye 'chi'i 'tshub ma myur//rga 'bras thod la bsdus pa'i byams ldan ma//'khyar 'khyor 'chi lam 'dun pa'i snang brnyan 'dis//8 0

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/sems pa dmar po 'di la bred sha 'don//skyo gdung tsher ma'i mal sar thol gyis lhung //pha lo'i khyim gzhi skyongs ba'i blo rtse'i re'i 'og/ma lo'i zung khrag dron pos zas bskal bgos//goms pa 'khyar 'khyor spo ba'i rtsed mo yis//pha ma'i sems khams dmar por dgod sgra slangs//dka' sdug rngul nag char ba'i nyin mtshan bar//pha ma'i dung ba bu lo'i bde la gtad//slob grwa'i slob ma zhig la re bcol byas//rngul chu'i khur po rang nyid kho nas myang //bdag 'dzin bdag bde rgod pa'i gru kha na//yod tshad gzhan la sbyin pa'i blo spobs can//mi yi mtshan nyid ster ba'i brtse ba can//bka' drin ri la 'phya ba'i pha la lags//chos dung dkar po'i 'od zer chem pa yi//8 1

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/'khor yug bco brgyad bgreng byas 'dun pa'i dus//'di phyi'i lam phran 'od kyis snang byed pa'i//pha mas sgron me zhig gi ri mo bris//'don cha'i bklags bam thug po'i dbyangasarta'i bar//le lo sgyud lug cig gi de nyid bton// —dge rgan lhag bsam 'dzum pa'i yid mkha' la//nag nyes stig po zhig gi bzha' ris bris//yod tshad stong ba'i bgreng bya'i sne ma 'dir//shugs ring 'gyod pas rang sems rtags tu gtses//'dangs gsum rmis pa'i rmi lam ring mo 'di//yod tshad phyir dran byed pa'i cong brda red//brtse med bu lo'i 'gro ba'i 'gro stangs 'dis//pha ma'i brang la sdug yas bar med brtsegs//drin chen pha mas gnang ba'i bka' drin 'di//nus med 'khyam pos drin lam ci ltar mjal//8 2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅/ /mtshan mo zhig gi rmi lam/ /kher rkyang khang mig gi lhing 'jags// sems kyi skyo snang la 'tsher dus//mi rkyang 'tsho ba yi lhags rlung // skyo ba'i yang gting la 'byug song //rme bdun nam dkyil la slebs kyang // gnyid kyi bu mo de ma khugs//dbyangs ldan kha par gyi lam nas// phyi rol 'jig rten la snyeg go/las dbang spyi gtsug la bsgom dus// las kyi me tog zhig mthong byung //rkang drug sbrang ma la brdzus nas/ /gtam gleng sbrang rtsi la rol lo/ /phan tshun gsung gleng gi gting du// bcos min brtse zhen zhig 'grub byung //kher rkyang skyo snang de yal yang // brtse zhen sdug bsngal zhig slebs song //sems kyi gsang tshigs de bshad kyang // dbyangs ldan kha par gyi bu mos//lus kyi kha dog gcig min yang // sems kyi 'phar lding de gcig zer//lcang gling byi'u de mjol mo// thod byung las rlung zhig lding nas//8 3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/yid kyi chu bo de 'dres kyang // gtan du 'grogs thub zhig mi 'dug/byang phyogs khu byug de nga rang // mi kha'i ston rlung de lding tshe//lus kyi mdzes sdug de yal 'gro// ngag gi glu dbyangs de 'gag 'gro//lus kyi rdong gdegs kyi me kha// che yang nyin 'ga' yi sdug bsngal//dmar chung sems pa yi rma kha// chung yang tshe gcig gi sdug bsngal//khu lor brtse sems zhig yod na// mjol mo kher rkyang la ma skyur//khyod dang 'bral dgos re byung tshe// sems kyi bzod pa zhig min gsungs//gu re gtam gleng gi dpal 'di //skyo ba sangs thabs la bsam yang //skyo sangs rgyang ring la bros te// skyo bas skyo ba zhig khyer yong //las kyi bu mo de sgrol mas// gu re rtsed ba re min nam//dkon cog rje brtsun de sgrol mas// thugs rje gzhan phyogs la ma g.yo//8 4

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄༅//rang nyid brlag pa'i rtsed mo//'jig rten mi yi lus 'di blangs nas bzung //mi dal 'bad pa'i kun gyi rjes su rgyug/de yi khrod nas mi yi lus 'di rgas//de yi tshe na rmi lam bzhin du 'das//nga dang 'odra bo'i 'ojig rten skye bo dag/dal 'byar dan yad phyags la rgyug rgyug kyang //mtha' 'bras rang nyid rang gis brlag pa las//dal ba 'byor ba'i snying po dbyings su yal//phye ma'i khang bu 'jig par dog pa 'di//snga nas bzhags pa'i yi/ 'thus zhen pa'i 'phrul//'khrul bar shes na rdo ga dang ma dog med//de nyid ma rigs kho bo 'di ltar 'khyam//sdug bsngal myong tshe bde ba med do snyam//8 5

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/bde ba rnyed tshe sdug bsngal med do snyam//rang mgo rang gis bskor ba'i nga dang nga //skyid sgyid snyam yang sdug gis btang ba med//yar gyi yon tan mthong nas yod na 'dod//lam gyi dka' sdug rigs nas rgyang la bkyed//mar gyi sdug bsngal mthong nas nges 'byung skyes//lam la zhugs dus nges 'byung brdzun phugs rdib//bya las thams cad col chung spre'u'i las//gnad la khel ba'i don dag gcig ma 'grub//'das pa'i las la rjes dran gcig byas na//shugs ring stong gi nad gzhi ngang gis 'byung //blo chung byis pa 'dra ba'i skye bo ngas//kun gyis 'phya ba'i gnas zhig mi 'dod kyang //rang 'tshang gsal por shar ba'i skabs 'di la//mi 'dod bzhin du mi snyan bstun mar 'byung //8 6

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7/ /re skug khrod kyi 'jol mo//nyi ma nub la nub song // mun pas mtha' nas bsdus byung //lcang gseb bye'u 'jol mo// kher rkyang sdug gis mnar song //skyo gdung glu dbyangs phra mo// gnam mtha'i zla bar langs byung //mdzes ldan zla ba dkar po// dar cig gsan pa gnong dang //phyogs bzhi'i rgyal khams bskor na// skyid po bde mo yong ngam//sin dhi rgya mtsho'i kha na// me tog pad+ma yod dam//ma la ya yi nagasan// lha bya khu 81 bzhugs sam//glu dbyangs len par 'dug gam// 'di ru pheb pa gsung ngam//dus bzhi rim par rgyud nas//lo grangasari bo mnyam thal//khu lor re ba'i khrod nas// lusakyi spu mdog 'gyur thal//8 7

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/dpyid 'go'i me tog rgum nas// mchu sgros lang tsho zad thal//lcang ma glang ma'i bar nas// lus po'i sgro spu thor thal//da lo dgun khar slebs song // dgun 'go'i kha ba babs byung //sa gzhi lhag pas bsdam song // 'jol mo'i re thag chad song //zla bas rgyal khams nyul dus// khu la 'phrad pa byung na//khrag gis bris pa'i 'phrin 'di// dpyid kyi pho nyar sprod shog/khu lo 'phur ba'i shul na// nus med byi'u 'jol mo'i//lcang ma glang ma'i gseb nas// sems pa snag gis bzung thal//lo zla stong phrag bar nas// re sgug ri mo khyod bris//sems kyi skyo glu khyod langs// rmi lam ring mo khyod rmis//8 8

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/ston mawo zla 'od ngogs nas// mig chu'i chu rgyun khyod btang //chu chen pha bong 'gram nas// re sgug mig zung ma kem//lus kyi lang tsho rgas kyang // sems kyi brtse dung rgasamed//khu lor sems pa yod na// myur mor bod la byon shog/༵—mitram̐rngerdengh+rutsho rī9li nga lho rigre bhet+yā tre ci ldo'u — — kekhaṃ 4 k+ṣi—spre — (tre 9 —༄ waḍāhūṃlkesna — shi ngh+ru ske bhe —kheci tretsho cho—spyo ru—ge )mu skud+ku catshe / rno 4— dicotram̐dzilkene—rdzo— — ci྾chordze— ༷ d+ku dzā tho cirjo// 8 9

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄ nga'i glu//'jig rten mdza' mo'i brtse dung g.yon nas skyur//pha dang bu yi brtse dung g.yas nas skyur//phugs bsam gser 'od 'khyug pa'i zhing sa la//gzan sham srab mo'i nang nas smon pa spur//'jig rten 'ur zing che ba'i sne mo nas//khyad 'phags dben gnas shig gi 'khor yug skyangs//'tsho bsdod skam po 'di yi reg bya de//grwa rkyang gnyom chung zhig gi las la babs//khang mig gru bzhi char dang thig pas mnar//phung po'i lang tsho rga ba'i lhag pas gtses//snying khams dmar po kher rkyang las kyis sdug/grwa rkyang dbyangs rta dmar po de nas 'phur//rgyag phye phran bu byi bas skog 'gren byas//ltog 'bras skyur mo mngon sum pho bas myang //9 0

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/gzan sham rlung gis bskyod pa'i gru kha 'dir//kher rkyang las 'bras zhig gi de nyed mthong //kher rkyang sdug yas mkhur ba'i lus 'di la//na chung bu mos khrel 'dzum gtong na yang //yab mas pha 'khar dkar po'i mdzes sdug la//dbugs 'gyi phra mo'i skye 'chi gtan bcol byas//slab gsum sdom khrims gnong med rlung gis khyer// grong ba rgan pos bstan zhug ming byang gnang //chos srid gnyis kyi dkar nag so kha na//grwa rkyang zhig gi las dbang 'dar sig sig/mi kha'i thor rlung 'khor yug kun la ldang //gzan sham dmar po rdul nag 'tshub mas dkrugs//bzod zan dka' ba'i sems kyi me kha 'di//dus mtha'i grwa rkyang kho bo'i tshe nad gyur//9 1

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄/ /rlung rta/char gshol che ba'i mtshan mo// snying rlung stod la 'tshang byung //sdug gtam mig chu'i rlabs gnyer// lho phyogs mon la btang yod//bla mkhar mthon po'i gzi mdangs// smug sprin nag pos sgrib dus//gangs can bod pa'i bla srog/ phye ma'i thang chen 'grim song //khu byug lho la phur dus// 'jol mos rang tshigs ma zin//gangs phrug dung byur du ma'i// tshe srog rlung la bskur song //pha mes bong mdzod chen po// byi ba'i bsdod gnas gyur dus//ri sde'i sde dpon rgan po// shog bu'i klong na 'khor 'dug/khyim phugs 'dra sku'i byin rlabs// sgor mo'i dpal la brje dus//bod mi'i la rgya'i rlung rta// lung gsum mdo ru lhung song //9 2

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/༄7// grogs po'i bzang ngan//bu nga tsho sa mtha' 'grim pa'i dus//myi bzang ngan gnyis la 'grogs nas song //grogs bzang ngan gnyis kyi gnas lugs kyang //don gsal thag chod pa de nas shes//grogs ngan pa zhig gi gtam rgyud ni//grogs ma gyur sngon la bzang mdog che//gtam bshad tshad ka la pang ka yin//zla lnga bar yod na drug pa med//sems bsam pa dbyar kha'i char gshol 'dra//rang skyid dus yod kyang sdug dusamed//las byas tshad lcong mo mgo ldog 'dra//mthar phyin pa'i don bzang gcig kyang med//9 3

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/grogs bzang po zhig gi rgyu mtshan ni//grogs 'phrad ma thag la bzang mdog med//gtam bshad tshad dam pa'i legs bshad yin//don bzang po sgrub pa'i bskul brda yin//sems bsam pa gangs dkar lhun po 'dra//rang skyid dus yod la sdug dus yod//las byas tshad don ldan gzhan phan yin//grogs zhi thag ring la blo khog yangs//grogs bzang ngan 'byed pa'i glu chung 'di//bu sdom po zhig gi myong tshor yin//gzhan grong mtha' 'grum pa'i 'bras bu yin//grogs mang por 'grogs pa'i gnas lugs yin//9 4

grwa rkyang gi dbyangs rta/ma〈cog gi gtam/'di ltar gleng ba'i 'bras chang skya bo 'dir//mkhas par 'dzums mdangs grol ba'i zhus mngar med//glen par blo spobs rgyas pa'i nus mthu med//gad mo'i rang sgra bslong ba'i slong mo yin//dus kyi zla ba dgod pa'i yul gru na//snyan ngag bdud rtsi'i dro ba ci yang gleng //mdzes sdug med pa'i zhing thang skya bo nas//zla ba'i 'phel 'grib rigs nasaglu zhig blangs//skabs rer nges 'byung dkar po'i ri mo 'phabs//skabs rer bu mor dung ba'i mdza' gzhas blangs//dge sdig 'dres ma brtsegasapa'i 'brasachang 'di//lab rdol skyur mo zhig gi 'phar rtsar bsnun//9 5
